_comment: The CS answer corpus. ADR-0001 (QST-CORPUS-PROVENANCE = C into A): hand-drafted with a gloss per word, ratified by the human strike-a-row, committed here as a reviewable diff. NOT generated at build time and NOT derived from an external glossary — provenance is the point.
_status_note: Setter 5 drafted these 66 candidates on 2026-11-12; Stanley's strike-a-row review is pending. Shipped in this state deliberately so the game is playable before the review rather than blocked on it (ADR-0001, QST-CORPUS-SCALE-60 = B). Ratification is a PRUNE: strike rows, flip _status to "ratified", fill _ratified_by and _ratified_on.

_policy.length: Exactly 5 letters, A-Z uppercase only (ADR-0001 Explicitation). Excludes O(n), B-TREE, 2FA, UTF-8 and friends by design.
_policy.plurals: Excluded. NODES/EDGES/BYTES/TYPES/PAGES/GATES all fit, but each is a near-duplicate of a word the player already knows, and at ~60 words two near-duplicates are 3% of the game. ADR-0001 carries this as an open policy row.
_policy.proper_nouns: Excluded. LINUX/REACT/NGINX are five letters and clearly CS, but they date fast and read as trivia rather than vocabulary.
_policy.conf: The drafter's own confidence. 'high' = defensible to a player who complains. 'med' = a visible argument against it (jargon-specific, an abbreviation, or a verb), listed anyway so the human gets real strike decisions.
